description:
## Why
fz has no defguard (none in lib/ or src/). Elixir's only way to name a guard expression is defguard/defguardp; the twins of 01114 and 01115 already spell their helper as `defguardp first(l) when hd(l)`.

## What changes
`defguard name(args) when expr` and `defguardp` define a guard that expands in guard position (and is callable outside guards), as in Elixir. Its body must be guard-safe; a body that is not is a spanned diagnostic. Three-path parity (run, interp, build).

## Signal
Oracle fixtures (Elixir form, `# oracle: self`) for a public and a private defguard used in a def head, a case clause, a receive clause and outside a guard; a diagnostic fixture for a non-guard-safe body; full gate green.

OTP json.erl parity (fz-mue) needs this; reproducer from the faithful port: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/punch/20_defguardp_chain.fz
When this lands, Record.is_record/1,2 becomes a defguard; it is a guard-safe defmacro until then (Elixir Parity, fz-mue.12).

title: defguard and defguardp define guards, as in Elixir
